methodology.topology: workspace manifests; production edges include dependencies, peerDependencies, and optionalDependencies
methodology.updates: git commits touching each package path, based on author date
methodology.pack: npm pack --dry-run --json --ignore-scripts against locally built package contents
methodology.bundle: esbuild browser ESM, ES2020, minified and tree-shaken; third-party dependencies external
methodology.benchmark: CI=true, warm dependency install, sequential runs; build medians use three runs and gates use one run
